objective: 保留三模式PDM核，落实角空间HDI/ETI/mean及tan报告、全域viridis四联图与三评估数值、图6文献对照、指定sigma/I=.3与P80%/R10%注入恢复图表、缺失纯E2校准、易用教程与验收后新版本交付。

statistics.hdi_center: For each connected HDI interval, argmax of the PDF restricted to that interval; transform that coordinate with tan.
statistics.mean: tan(angle mean), tan(angle mean +/- angle SD); report undefined/out-of-domain endpoints honestly
statistics.sigma_axis: sigma/I; I identity remains source reference state

plot.observation_domain: all finite valid response points and measured errorbars
plot.title_semantics: full scan with constant additional weight, not fixed sigma

analysis_installation: Not a second package; notebooks are files, shared core installed once, [analysis] adds optional dependencies but does not download notebooks.

- 依赖：U00。
- 文件：contracts.py、pdm/statistics.py、io/export.py及统计测试。
- 测试：构造归一三角/双峰PDF，验证q16/50/84、mean/std、逐HDI区间mode、HDI阈值与分段；双峰被分成两段时必须返回两个各在本段内的mode，不能复制全局峰；对所有端点/中心逐项tan，证明没有改为对delta重新求HDI；近边界均值/并列峰处理。
- 验收：68%面积和归一误差<=1e-6，取向变换守恒；默认输出三评估、正确坐标元数据；Mean±SD不标68%概率保证。
- 命令：GUI目录 `python -m pytest tests/test_statistics.py tests/test_mapping.py tests/test_export_measures.py -q`。
